raw_precheck_receipt.mutation: Remove final enemy queen exclusion from unchanged expression

commands.check.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
out=/workspace/shared/forge-build/weak-queen-mask/precheck
repo=/workspace/shared/forge-git/forge-combo29
cd "$out/forge-combo29"
flags=(-std=c++20 -O3 -DNDEBUG -DFORGE_NNUE_HIDDEN=256 -DFORGE_EXPOSE_TUNABLES=1 -DFORGE_SPD_TT_NOTLS=1 -DFORGE_SPD_NO_ZERO_MOVELISTS=2 -DFORGE_SEARCH_SPEED2=1 -DFORGE_SPD_PREFETCH_EARLY=1 -DFORGE_SPD_SLIDER_PEXT=1 -DFORGE_SPD_NNUE_ZMM=1 -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math -march=x86-64-v4 -pthread -Iinclude -Isrc)
sources=("$repo/tests/weak_queen_unit.cpp" "$repo/tests/weak_queen_oracle.cpp" src/board.cpp src/bitboard.cpp src/eval_params.cpp)
g++-14 "${flags[@]}" "${sources[@]}" src/eval.cpp -o "$out/unit-original"
"$out/unit-original" "$repo/tests/equivalence_positions.fen" | tee "$out/original-unit.json"
python3 - "$out" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
p=Path(sys.argv[1]); text=(p/'forge-combo29/src/eval.cpp').read_text()
old='(enemy_sliders & ~board.pieces(Them, Queen))'
assert text.count(old)==1
(p/'eval-queen-mutant.cpp').write_text(text.replace(old,'(enemy_sliders)'))
old='''                const Bitboard enemy_sliders = (attacks::bishop(square, occupied) & (board.pieces(Them, Bishop) | board.pieces(Them, Queen))) |
                                               (attacks::rook(square, occupied) & (board.pieces(Them, Rook) | board.pieces(Them, Queen)));
                if ((enemy_sliders & ~board.pieces(Them, Queen)) != 0) acc.template add<Us>(WeakQueen);'''
new='''                const Bitboard enemy_sliders = (attacks::bishop(square, occupied) & board.pieces(Them, Bishop)) |
                                               (attacks::rook(square, occupied) & board.pieces(Them, Rook));
                if (enemy_sliders != 0) acc.template add<Us>(WeakQueen);'''
assert text.count(old)==1
(p/'eval-prototype.cpp').write_text(text.replace(old,new))
PY
g++-14 "${flags[@]}" "${sources[@]}" "$out/eval-queen-mutant.cpp" -o "$out/unit-queen-mutant"
set +e
"$out/unit-queen-mutant" "$repo/tests/equivalence_positions.fen" > "$out/queen-mutant-red.log" 2>&1
rc=$?
set -e
cat "$out/queen-mutant-red.log"
[[ $rc == 1 ]]
for kind in original prototype; do
  src=src/eval.cpp; [[ $kind == original ]] || src="$out/eval-prototype.cpp"
  g++-14 "${flags[@]}" -c "$src" -o "$out/$kind.o" -fdump-tree-optimized="$out/$kind.optimized"
  objdump -d -C "$out/$kind.o" > "$out/$kind.assembly"
done
size "$out/original.o" "$out/prototype.o"
cmp -s "$out/original.o" "$out/prototype.o" && exit 1 || true
g++-14 "${flags[@]}" "${sources[@]}" "$out/eval-prototype.cpp" -o "$out/unit-prototype"
"$out/unit-prototype" "$repo/tests/equivalence_positions.fen" | tee "$out/prototype-unit.json"
commands.blocker-mutation.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
out=/workspace/shared/forge-build/weak-queen-mask/precheck
root=/workspace/shared/forge-build/weak-queen-mask/frozen/source/forge-combo29
repo=/workspace/shared/forge-git/forge-combo29
python3 - "$root" "$out" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
text=(Path(sys.argv[1])/'src/eval.cpp').read_text()
a,b=text.split('#if FORGE_SPD_WEAK_QUEEN_MASK',1)
on,off=b.split('#else',1)
assert on.count('square, occupied')==2
on=on.replace('square, occupied','square, occupied ^ board.pieces(Them, Queen)')
(Path(sys.argv[2])/'eval-blocker-mutant.cpp').write_text(a+'#if FORGE_SPD_WEAK_QUEEN_MASK'+on+'#else'+off)
PY
cd "$root"
g++-14 -std=c++20 -O3 -DNDEBUG -DFORGE_NNUE_HIDDEN=256 -DFORGE_EXPOSE_TUNABLES=1 -DFORGE_SPD_TT_NOTLS=1 -DFORGE_SPD_NO_ZERO_MOVELISTS=2 -DFORGE_SEARCH_SPEED2=1 -DFORGE_SPD_PREFETCH_EARLY=1 -DFORGE_SPD_SLIDER_PEXT=1 -DFORGE_SPD_NNUE_ZMM=1 -DFORGE_SPD_WEAK_QUEEN_MASK=1 -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math -march=x86-64-v4 -pthread -Iinclude -Isrc "$repo/tests/weak_queen_unit.cpp" "$repo/tests/weak_queen_oracle.cpp" src/{board,bitboard,eval_params}.cpp "$out/eval-blocker-mutant.cpp" -o "$out/unit-blocker-mutant"
set +e
"$out/unit-blocker-mutant" "$repo/tests/equivalence_positions.fen" > "$out/blocker-mutant-red.log" 2>&1
rc=$?
set -e
cat "$out/blocker-mutant-red.log"
[[ $rc == 1 ]]
